data.executed_search_definition: completed logical retriever searches from actual_retrieval_stats; excludes final do_search=False and does not count HTTP retries

budget.optimizer_step_count_semantics: opportunities; actual successful writes reported separately

data.source_snapshot_semantics: disk fingerprint before launch; not proof of loaded modules
data.optimizer_semantics: fresh Adam, scheduler, RNG and sampler; official fresh actor; no prior checkpoint or diagnostic state
data.retrieval_placement: pending actual resource and retrieval-equivalence admission
data.ray_tmp_retention: remote original Ray logs retained; owned processes cleaned by pipeline
